messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to lock SLA + ops checklist for Ship Sentinel GA. Can we confirm targets, support path, and docs checklist by EOD Wed? cc @sam @rohit
sam: Want to avoid the last-minute SLA wrangle. My baseline: uptime 99.95% for hosted, p99 gen latency <=250ms. Dedicated might be slightly different. Thoughts?
rohit: Dedicated should be more about throughput guarantees than single-node latency. Propose: p99 200ms for short seqs (<512 tokens), p99 350ms for long seqs. Uptime target 99.9% for Dedicated pools.
elena: Docs runway: SLA page, runbook, severity matrix, telemetry dashboard links, and a minimal troubleshooting checklist. I can own the runbook if someone gives me the SLO numbers.
maya: Perfect — I'll own the public SLA page. Can we sketched a minimal SLO YAML for ops to paste into the runbook?
sam: Sure — initial draft:```yaml
slo:
  hosted:
    uptime_pct: 99.95
    p99_ms: 250
  dedicated:
    uptime_pct: 99.9
    p99_ms_short: 200
    p99_ms_long: 350
error_budget_days: 7
escalation: "S1 -> paging, S2 -> email; S1 response < 1h"
```
devops-bot: Reminder: canary + automated health checks required for GA. Add explicit health-check steps to runbook and a /deploy health-check command snippet.
rohit: Support model: 24/7 paged SRE for S1 incidents, S2 handled by oncall during business hours with 4h SLA. We should surface an optional "Premium SLA" add-on for customers who need faster response.
maya: On pricing: Product wants tiered SLA pricing. Minimal mapping proposal: free/dev = best-effort; standard = 99.9% (email support); premium = 99.95% (1h response + phone escalation). Need to map quotas/rate-limits to each tier.
sam: Also: FinOps asked for per-token cost simulation for 100 qps and 1M monthly tokens so we can price the premium tier. I'll run numbers and share a sheet. Quotas: suggest default 60rps, burst to 300rps for standard, dedicated has contract-based throughput.
elena: Telemetry checklist for GA: p50/p90/p99 latency, error rate, latency-by-model, tail percentiles, request volume, token throughput, and fast links from incident runbook to the dashboard charts. I'll add dashboard tiles to the Console.
maya: Action items: Maya -> SLA page + public wording; Elena -> runbook + dashboards; Sam -> finalize SLO numbers, rate-limit table, and cost sims; Rohit -> oncall rota + capacity SLOs + fallback policies. Commit by Wed EOD?
sam: :thumbsup: I'll have SLO numbers and the rate-limit draft by Tue afternoon.
rohit: I'll draft oncall rota and fallback plan (auto-degrade to smaller model + throttled queue) and sync with SRE.
maya: Thanks. Quick sync tomorrow 09:30 for 15m to lock the wording. /remind #product tomorrow 09:15 "Ship Sentinel SLA sync"
devops-bot: Note: please add a canary checklist block to the runbook including: healthcheck URL, sample probe curl, and rollback trigger thresholds.
maya: Good catch — adding that to Elena's runbook tasks. Anything else?
elena: One more: include a short "what we promise" blurb for sales that avoids technical SLO jargon but clearly lists uptime, response time tiers, and support response windows. I can draft it.
maya: Awesome. If we all hit these, we can include SLA tables in the GA announcement. Closing for now — will follow up in the sync.
